title: Daq eyebrow
description: A tiny uppercase monospace label with wide tracking ('01 / SECTION NAME'), optionally followed by a hairline rule. The rule can carry an inner fill that a parent animates (a scroll progress line).
notes: needs a monospace in the theme's --typeface-mono
rule='fill' stretches the rule to the row's end; 'short' is 280px at desktop
name: daq-eyebrow

props.name: label
props.description: the label, e.g. "01 / How it flows" (shown uppercase)

props.name: rule
props.description: a hairline after the label: none, a 280px rule (full width on phones) or one to the row's end

props.name: strong
props.description: bold, full-strength label (the manifesto's) instead of the quiet 58% one

props.name: ruleFillClassName
props.description: classes for a fill line inside the rule, for a parent to animate (e.g. a scroll progress)
